_comment: Budget input for `attribution.ts --budgets`. It declares the four legs the
spec requires and the number of consecutive green CI runs collected for
each. Phase 9 (2026-09-08) collected the first post-merge `main` run
(`baseline/34173378609/`), so every leg stands at one; the gate still
refuses to derive a budget until each leg has three and
`perLegFamilySummed` is filled from the stored JUnit artifacts. Nothing
yet joins a JUnit identity to a family — `attribution.ts` reads nextest
logs — so the families stay empty until that aggregator exists; see
`log.md` § Phase 9. Local timing lives in `attribution.md` and is never a
budget input — a `kind` of `local` is refused before any leg is read.
